name: Golden Sushi Night
source:
Take control of Addy, a farm girl who had just moved to the big city, as she stumbles through her first week of being a sushi chef at the Golden Nori. It's not that the job itself is difficult, it's the pretty customers that'll trip her up. Even before settling into her new apartment Addy has been eager to chat up one of the local girls. It's the whole reason she made the move. It was slim pickings at the isolated farm she grew up on so she's eager to find a soulmate.  The five potential partners she meets at the Golden Nori are as varied as they come.

Addy is a dork who has trouble flirting. It'll be your job as the player to choose the correct things to say. Then you'll choose who Addy will spend the rest of her life with at the end of the game. In paying tribute to Halloween, your options range from a witch to a scarecrow inhabited by a ghost. 

[from [url=https://fava-beans.itch.io/golden-sushi-night]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演刚刚从农场搬到大城市的女孩艾蒂，陪她跌跌撞撞地度过在“金海苔”担任寿司师傅的第一周。倒不是这份工作本身有多难，真正让她手忙脚乱的是店里那些漂亮的顾客。早在搬进新公寓安顿下来之前，艾蒂就一直盼着能和城里的姑娘搭上话——毕竟这正是她搬来大城市的全部理由。她从小长大的偏远农场里实在没什么择偶余地，因此她迫切渴望找到自己的灵魂伴侣。而在“金海苔”邂逅的五位潜在交往对象，可谓个个独具特色。

艾蒂是个一调情就嘴笨的呆瓜，作为玩家的你必须帮她选出得体的台词，并在故事尾声决定谁将与艾蒂共度余生。作为向万圣节致敬的作品，你的攻略人选从女巫到幽灵附身的稻草人，可谓应有尽有。

[摘自[url=https://fava-beans.itch.io/golden-sushi-night]itch.io[/url]]
